## Poisson & mixed Poisson {#sec-frequency-mixed-poisson}

*This is a recipe for* the workhorse counts: the plain `poisson`, and the gamma-mixed Poisson (a negative binomial) written `mixed gamma <cv>`. The mixing CV — the *contagion* — is how much the annual frequency over-disperses beyond Poisson, and it is usually the single most important tail assumption in the book.

```{python}
from _setup import *
```

The house book uses `mixed gamma 0.25`:

```{python}
pp(house('FreqDemo'))
```
